abstract_sentences.text: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) arises in many real-world applications where trade-offs between competing objectives must be carefully balanced.

evidence.anchor: trade-offs between competing objectives must be carefully balanced

abstract_sentences.text: In the offline setting, where only a static dataset is available, the main challenge is generalizing beyond observed data.

evidence.anchor: only a static dataset is available

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion (PCD), a novel framework that formulates offline MOO as a conditional sampling problem.

evidence.anchor: formulates offline MOO as a conditional sampling problem

abstract_sentences.text: By conditioning directly on desired trade-offs, PCD avoids the need for explicit surrogate models.

evidence.anchor: conditioning directly on desired trade-offs

abstract_sentences.text: To effectively explore the Pareto front, PCD employs a reweighting strategy that focuses on high-performing samples and a reference-direction mechanism to guide sampling towards novel, promising regions beyond the training data.

evidence.anchor: focuses on high-performing samples and a reference-direction mechanism

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on standard offline MOO benchmarks show that PCD achieves highly competitive performance and, importantly, demonstrates greater consistency across diverse tasks than existing offline MOO approaches.

evidence.anchor: greater consistency across diverse tasks

introduction_moves.next_hook: 需要直接把目标 trade-off 接到生成过程

evidence.anchor: inheriting the same potential risks of exploiting inaccuracies in the surrogate model

introduction_moves.paragraph: Contribution 段提出 PCD，把 candidate generation 和 Pareto-front modeling 合并进 conditional generative model，免去显式 objective approximation。
introduction_moves.previous_problem: 多阶段管线依赖 surrogate 或 separate optimizer
introduction_moves.current_answer: 以 target objectives 直接条件化 diffusion model
introduction_moves.next_hook: 仍须解决高质量区域偏向与 front coverage

evidence.anchor: PCD offers a more direct, end-to-end framework

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 直接条件生成如何产生高质量且多样的 target
introduction_moves.current_answer: 两个组件分别处理高质量偏向和多样 trade-off 覆盖
introduction_moves.next_hook: 转入 related work 与方法基础

evidence.anchor: two key algorithmic contributions

related_work_moves.paragraph: 按 DNN/GP surrogate 与后接 MOEA 的结构分类 offline MOO；指出多阶段性能受 surrogate accuracy bottleneck。
related_work_moves.previous_problem: 需要说明 PCD 相对传统 offline MOO 的位置
related_work_moves.current_answer: 传统路径先拟合目标再搜索，误差集中在 surrogate
related_work_moves.next_hook: 转向直接生成的 generative methods

evidence.anchor: The performance of this multi-stage pipeline is fundamentally bottlenecked

related_work_moves.paragraph: 列 ParetoFlow、PGD-MOO、LaMBO、MOGFNs，比较 predictor、Bayesian optimization、scalarization 依赖；建立中间 guidance 缺口。
related_work_moves.previous_problem: generative model 是否已经摆脱多阶段搜索
related_work_moves.current_answer: 现有 generative 方法仍需要 predictor 或 scalarization
related_work_moves.next_hook: 给出 PCD 的直接条件化差异

evidence.anchor: effectiveness of these methods is still dependent on a surrogate predictor

related_work_moves.paragraph: 把 PCD 与 MINs/DDOM 的 single-objective conditional generation 联系，再与 reward-directed single-reward diffusion 区分，给出 multi-objective extension 的位置。
related_work_moves.previous_problem: 直接条件生成在多目标场景中的先例和边界是什么
related_work_moves.current_answer: PCD 将 single-objective conditional generation 扩展到 conflicting objectives
related_work_moves.next_hook: 进入 MOO 与 conditional diffusion 的 formal background

evidence.anchor: removes this dependency on intermediate guidance mechanisms

method_moves.paragraph: 把 x 定义为 candidate solution、y 定义为 target objectives，声明 diffusion model 学习 p(x|y;σ)。

evidence.anchor: PCD reframes offline MOO as a conditional generation problem

method_moves.paragraph: 从需要超越 offline dataset 的目标出发，说明低质量区域不应占据同等训练权重；提醒 pruning 会增大 training-objective variance。

evidence.anchor: Simply pruning poorly performing points can increase the variance

method_moves.paragraph: 用 dominance number 统计支配样本数，避免多目标向量不存在 total ordering 时用单点距离排序。

evidence.anchor: a lower dominance number indicates that a point performs better

method_moves.paragraph: 把 objective space 划成等宽 bins；weight 同时强调 bin density 与平均 dominance，K 平滑 bin size、τ 控制 weighting temperature。

evidence.anchor: emphasize bins that contain more points, and are well-performing on average

method_moves.paragraph: 将 w(y) 乘入 EDM denoising objective，形成 Eq.7 的 reweighted L2 loss。

evidence.anchor: resulting in the reweighted denoising L2 objective

method_moves.paragraph: 指出 single-objective 的简单 target 选择无法覆盖整条 Pareto front，因此需要 Q 个既高质量又 diverse 的 conditioning points。

evidence.section: §4 Generating a diverse set of conditioning points
evidence.anchor: designed to be both high-quality and diverse

method_moves.paragraph: 用 Riesz s-Energy 生成 L 个 directions；对 dataset 做 non-dominated sorting；每个 direction 先接 perpendicular-distance 最近点，其余按当前 niche count 最小的 direction 分配，直至 Q 对。

evidence.section: §4 Generating a diverse set of conditioning points
evidence.anchor: each direction vector gets assigned a point that is closest to it

method_moves.paragraph: 沿 direction 外推以提高目标质量；当 Q>L、多个点共享 direction 时加 zero-mean Gaussian noise 恢复多样性。

evidence.section: §4 Generating a diverse set of conditioning points
evidence.anchor: adding zero-mean Gaussian noise to the extrapolated points

method_moves.paragraph: 对每个 ŷ 用 CFG 混合 conditional 与 unconditional denoiser；论文预期其强化目标 trade-off 的 adherence。

evidence.anchor: strongly enforces adherence to the conditioning signal

method_moves.paragraph: Algorithm 1 将 reweighted training、Algorithm 2 target generation、纯噪声初始化、S-step denoising 和 Q 个输出串接。

evidence.anchor: Output: Candidate set X with |X| = Q

experimental_design.name: research questions / formal hypotheses
experimental_design.description: §5 直接写 validate performance/components，没有独立编号的 research-question 或 pre-registered hypothesis 列表；CFG 与若干 appendix analysis 后续才以 hypothesize 形式出现。

evidence.anchor: We conducted extensive experiments to validate the performance

experimental_design.name: Offline MOO benchmark
experimental_design.description: 使用 Xue et al. Offline MOO benchmark，覆盖 synthetic、MORL、RE、scientific design、MONAS 五类。

evidence.anchor: five diverse task categories

experimental_design.name: Synthetic task coverage
experimental_design.description: 11 个连续函数、每个 60,000 点、2 或 3 objectives；DTLZ2–6 因原 benchmark evaluation error 排除。

evidence.anchor: datasets of 60,000 points each

experimental_design.name: MORL coverage
experimental_design.description: MO-Hopper 与 MO-Swimmer 为连续高维 policy-parameter tasks，数据来自 PGMORL training。

evidence.anchor: policy parameters collected during PGMORL training

experimental_design.name: RE coverage
experimental_design.description: 压力容器、rocket injector 等 engineering tasks；4–7 dimensions、2–6 objectives，部分 mixed-integer。

evidence.anchor: 4-7 dimensional search spaces and 2-6 objectives

experimental_design.name: Scientific Design coverage
experimental_design.description: 一个 32-dimensional molecule latent task 和三个 32–200 token discrete protein tasks。

evidence.anchor: one molecule design problem and three discrete protein design problems

experimental_design.name: MONAS coverage
experimental_design.description: 优化 accuracy、latency、parameter count；最多 34 个 categorical decision variables。

evidence.anchor: the only purely categorical task set

experimental_design.name: Discrete representation
experimental_design.description: 含 discrete values 的任务转成 continuous logits，沿用 prior work 的处理。

evidence.anchor: we convert them into continuous logits

experimental_design.name: Combinatorial exclusion
experimental_design.description: 原 benchmark 的 combinatorial tasks 未纳入；denoising/decoding 与 permutation constraint 改造留在 scope 外。

evidence.anchor: Adapting diffusion models to combinatorial domains requires substantial modifications

experimental_design.name: Evaluation metric
experimental_design.description: 使用 Hypervolume，作者解释它同时反映 uniformity、spread、convergence，并相对 best-known reference point 计算。

evidence.anchor: HV ... measuring its 1) uniformity, 2) spread, and 3) convergence

experimental_design.name: Candidate/query budget
experimental_design.description: PCD 每次生成 Q=256 candidates；surrogate baseline 用 NSGA-II 在 true oracle 上做 Q=256 evaluations；HV 报 100/75/50 percentiles。

evidence.anchor: generate a set of Q = 256 candidate solutions

experimental_design.name: Random seeds and aggregation
experimental_design.description: 主结果为 5 random seeds 的 mean ± standard deviation；A.4 runtime 使用 3 runs。

evidence.anchor: mean and standard deviation over 5 random seeds

experimental_design.name: Baseline families
experimental_design.description: 包含 D(best)、MOBO、E2E/MH/MM 及 PC/GN/COMs/ICT/IOM/TM 变体、qNEHVI、ParetoFlow。

evidence.anchor: compared against a comprehensive set of baselines

experimental_design.name: Hyperparameter control
experimental_design.description: 主结果使用一组固定 hyperparameters；A.3 给出 network、EDM、reweighting、conditioning-point defaults。

evidence.anchor: using a single, fixed set of hyperparameters

experimental_design.name: Training budget and architecture
experimental_design.description: Residual MLP width 512/depth 4，batch 512，最多 12,000 steps with early stopping，CFG dropout 0.25，EMA；EDM stochastic sampler 1024 steps。

evidence.anchor: trained with batch size of 512 for up to 12k steps with early stopping

experimental_design.name: Hardware
experimental_design.description: A.4 runtime 使用 Intel i5-12600K、64GB RAM、NVIDIA GeForce RTX3080。

evidence.anchor: NVIDIA GeForce RTX3080 GPU

experimental_design.name: Leakage / holdout control
experimental_design.description: 没有独立 train/test split、holdout 或 leakage test；训练期不访问 f 的约束被写明，但评估 oracle protocol 没有进一步划分说明。

evidence.anchor: without direct access to f during training

experimental_design.name: Failure criterion
experimental_design.description: 没有预先阈值式 failure criterion；成败主要由 HV、average rank 与 D(best) 对照表达。

evidence.anchor: The quality of the generated solution set is measured using the Hypervolume

experimental_design.name: Human evaluation
experimental_design.description: 本文研究 benchmark-based offline optimization，不含 participants 或 human rating。

evidence.anchor: standard offline MOO benchmark

experimental_design.name: Implementation disclosure
experimental_design.description: p.11 列出 source code、environment/data links、scripts/configurations/random seeds，并给出 GitHub URL。

final_judgment.single_storyline: offline MOO → conditional sampling；dominance-aware reweighting 把学习容量放到高质量区域，reference directions + front selection + extrapolation + noise 生成多样 targets，CFG 从同一 diffusion model 输出候选（p.4–6）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 问题定义、EDM/CFG equations、两个核心组件、Algorithm 1、Table 1 overall/category rank、Table 2 component ablation、Figure 3 guidance scale，以及 MORL/MONAS/combinatorial 边界（p.3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Algorithm 2、网络/EDM/default hyperparameters、runtime/complexity、sampler、tau/J/noise/direction/steps 消融、case studies、many-objective Table 8 与 Tables 9–32 逐任务 HV（p.16–33）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 三步机制图 + Eq.5→Eq.6→Eq.7 连续推导 + Table 2 组件对照 + Figure 8/9 成功/失败成对案例，把生成组件接到可观测决策量。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有 formal theorem 或 target-adherence/generalization guarantee；RE21 与 many-objective 为正，约 10,000 维 MO-Hopper 同时暴露 distribution-capture 失败（p.21–23）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 条件生成论文应让每个生成组件对应一个可观测决策量，同时报告近流形成功案例、远流形失败案例和 per-task/结构性分解，不让 aggregate table 单独承担泛化主张。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适合静态数据、目标向量和批量 oracle 的 offline optimization；categorical/combinatorial constraints、高维 parameter manifold、长尾数据质量要求单独验证 representation、constraint handling、temperature 与 extrapolation。
